title: Quick Views in Excel add-in disappearing
author: Michael_Laroche
content: Has anyone ever come across an issue where you've built out a quick view in excel and you open the workbook to refresh the quick views and they are all #refresh with the links broken?
solution_text: It sounds as if you are converting your Quick View to XFGetCells format. Once you do that, you will see the #REFRESH and your Quick View definition is deleted. Best thing to do is to make a copy of your QV before converting.
